7595.title: Completed plugin invocations retain cancellation bookkeeping
7595.rootCauseOneLine: Per-call AbortSignal.any composition registers bookkeeping against a live plugin stopping signal, with no completion cleanup.
7595.proposedFix: Decide the handler signal lifetime, then replace the composition with disposable cancellation forwarding and regression coverage.
7595.caveats: Production hourly memory slope was not measured. Automatic fix skipped because disposing links changes late cancellation behavior for retained handler signals.
